question: What ritual offerings are preferred by all goddesses in the left-hand path?
premises: In the left-hand path, goddesses are fond of recitation.
In the left-hand path, goddesses are also fond of bali offerings.
inference: Therefore, all goddesses in the left-hand path are pleased by recitation and bali offerings.
plain_english: All goddesses are fond of recitation, and in the left-hand path they are fond of bali offerings.
